; The Goose Mother's Portrait and Pain Portrait, facing front: one white goose whose five
; honking heads all grow from her own breast, the middle one looking out, the low two
; from her flanks above her spread wings.
; Drawn after the art of The Goose Mother: Wilds of Eldraine (woe) #204, by Jesper Ejsing.
; Scryfall ID: 1a55c370-d396-4c73-8ee2-83dc4c124005
; Each is 32 rows of 32; see KEY in build_sprites.lua for which character is which color.
; Once a portrait's .aseprite file is touched up by hand, that file is the truth, not this.
